title: An autohide panel's hitbox is half its size when cursor first dragged to the edge of the screen
line: Files dragged to the screen edge to reveal an auto-hide panel can now be dropped anywhere on the panel, including its outer margin.
explanation: When a drag is over the panel's margin (the strip between the screen edge and the widgets, where the pointer lands when it reveals an auto-hide panel), PanelView re-sends the drag event at the nearest point inside the containment. The widget under that point accepted the copy, but the original event stayed unaccepted, so Qt told the compositor the drop was refused, and it stayed refused until the pointer moved onto the widgets themselves. The change copies the accepted state and drop action of the forwarded DragEnter, DragMove and Drop events back to the original event.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: Keep the result of forwarded drag events

Drag events in the panel's margins are re-sent at a position inside the
containment, but whether that copy was accepted got lost, so drags that
entered through the margin were refused there; copy the result back.

BUG: 511107

media.caption: Master: file dragged to the left edge reveals the panel; held over the Dolphin launcher at x=12 (panel margin), the launcher shows no drag highlight
Fixed: same drag, the Dolphin launcher is highlighted as a drop target
Master: after releasing there, the drop is refused and nothing opens
Fixed: the drop is accepted and Dolphin opens the file

review.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in PanelView::event(): when DragEnter, DragMove, or Drop events in the panel margin are forwarded as synthetic events to the containment, their resulting dropAction and accepted state are now copied back to the original event. This directly resolves the half-hitbox drop refusal when dragging a file straight to a screen edge to reveal an auto-hide panel. Before/after screenshots and regression checks convincingly verify the fix.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in PanelView::event(): when DragEnter, DragMove, or Drop events in the panel margin are forwarded as synthetic events to the containment, their resulting dropAction and accepted state are now copied back to the original event. This directly resolves the half-hitbox drop refusal when dragging a file straight to a screen edge to reveal an auto-hide panel. Before/after screenshots and regression checks convincingly verify the fix.

Correct root cause in the right place: PanelView::event() forwards margin drag events to a copy at a position inside the containment but returned true without propagating the copy's accept state/action, so a DragEnter that arrives in the margin (exactly what happens when an auto-hide panel is revealed from the edge) is reported as refused and Qt keeps the drag refused until a move lands inside the containment directly; that explains both the 'forbidden at the edge' and 'fine after moving away and back' observations in the report. Copying dropAction and accepted back for DragEnter/DragMove/Drop is minimal and makes margin drops behave exactly like drops inside the containment. Before/after shots show the launcher's drop highlight and the drop opening Dolphin, with a sensible control and regression pass. Commit message and explanation match the diff.
